home.heroNetworkCaption:
A network of verified specialists
across Europe and internationally
home.processSub: Your doctor stays at the centre of your care. IMSOP arranges access to complementary expertise when it's medically relevant.
home.step1Text: Submit your request and upload your medical documents (lab results, imaging) through our highly secure platform.
home.step2Text: A qualified European specialist is assigned to your case and reviews your file thoroughly and confidentially.
home.step2Quote: An African patient, a local doctor, international expertise when it's needed.
home.step3Text: Receive a complete report with a confirmed diagnosis and clear treatment recommendations in under 72 hours.
home.delayNote: Average turnaround: <bold>72 hours</bold> once the case is complete.
home.specialtiesSub: IMSOP highlights the specialties where international expertise adds the most value.
home.specialtiesFooterNote: Pediatrics, nephrology, gastroenterology, pulmonology and rare diseases will follow after the pilot phase.
home.testimonial1Quote: Before the surgery, we needed certainty. The report confirmed the diagnosis and suggested a less invasive alternative.
home.testimonial2Quote: Everything happened from Yaoundé, no travel needed. My doctor received the report at the same time I did.
home.testimonial3Quote: The European colleague's opinion completed my own review. The patient stayed under my care, with more confidence.
home.finalCtaText: Create your case in a few minutes. You only pay once your file is complete and verified.
home.testimonialsExamplesTitle: What a second opinion looks like
home.testimonialsExamplesNotice: Illustrative situations. No patient testimonial has been published yet — the first ones will appear here once approved by medical coordination.
home.testimonial4Quote: The report recommended further tests before any decision. We gained clarity without losing time.
home.testimonial5Quote: An external, documented opinion let me explain the options to my patient with more confidence.

footer.tagline: International Medical Second Opinion Platform. An African program for second medical opinions and international tele-expertise. Pilot country: Cameroon.
footer.disclaimer: IMSOP does not replace your treating physician. No medical emergency should go through the platform.

forDoctors.title: A complementary opinion, never a replacement
forDoctors.intro: IMSOP rests on one simple principle: the international specialist never steps in for the local doctor — they support them. The treating physician remains the central figure in their patient's care.
forDoctors.doctorsText: Submit your cases on the platform and receive an answer.
forDoctors.doctorsItem2: Send one precise question to the coordination team, answered by the specialist in their report
forDoctors.specialistsText: Join the IMSOP network by submitting your diplomas and professional references for review by our medical committee before your account is activated.
forDoctors.specialistsItem1: Verification of diplomas and licence to practice
forDoctors.specialistsItem2: Manage your availability and your rates
forDoctors.ctaTitle: Are you a doctor or a healthcare institution?
forDoctors.ctaText: Join the IMSOP network to get an opinion on your cases from international expertise.
